In military [[cryptography]], a '''codress message''' is an [[encryption|encrypted]] message whose address is also encrypted.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/library/policy/navy/nrtc/14243_ch3.pdf|title=CHAPTER 3 - MESSAGES|accessdate=February 1, 2022}}</ref> This is usually done to prevent [[traffic analysis]].
